'''Apnok'k''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Apnok'k sold [[Gree technology]] aboard the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Ziost Shadow]]''.
